description.value:
Duration constant

Bulwark-flavored, open to all — redirected hits deal you half damage instead of full.

When an attack is redirected to you from another creature by any Deadhand ability, effect, or Trade feature, you take half damage from it. This applies before your resistances and your armor's item bonus, not after.

cinderfall.incomplete: Claims redirected attacks deal half damage to the caster before resistances/armor are applied. Every damage-reduction rule element in pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/ (Resistance, Weakness as negative, DexterityModifierCap) works on a flat integer value -- no percentage-based damage-reduction key exists anywhere in the engine.
